steps: Reduce the use of resources and avoid activities that cause pollution.
Reuse materials and products instead of throwing them away.
Recycle waste materials, such as paper, glass, metals and plastics, to conserve resources and reduce waste.
items.finalAnswer: Environmental issues can be addressed by reducing resource use, reusing materials and recycling waste.

steps: Exhaust from the large number of vehicles releases pollutants into the air.
Industries, power plants and brick kilns release smoke and harmful gases, especially when they burn fossil fuels.
Burning crop residues and waste adds smoke and fine particles to the air.
In winter, cold air near the ground and temperature inversion can trap pollutants close to the surface.
Calm winds and limited mixing of air allow pollutants to build up, while construction and road dust add further particles.
items.finalAnswer: Vehicle and industrial emissions, crop-residue burning, dust, and winter conditions that trap pollutants are major causes of high AQI.

steps: On hot summer days, warm air rises and promotes vertical mixing of the atmosphere.
Wind and convection disperse pollutants over a larger area instead of allowing them to remain concentrated near the ground.
Unlike winter temperature inversion, summer conditions generally do not trap pollutants close to the surface.
items.finalAnswer: Summer heat promotes air mixing and disperses pollutants, so they do not build up near the ground as they do in winter.

steps: Pakistan has experienced more frequent and intense heatwaves and unusually high temperatures.
Irregular and intense monsoon rainfall has caused severe flooding, including the devastating floods of 2022.
Rising temperatures have accelerated the melting of glaciers and increased the risk of glacial lake outburst floods.
Some areas have faced drought and water shortages, while changing rainfall and temperature patterns have affected crops and livelihoods.
items.finalAnswer: Climate change has intensified heatwaves, floods and glacier-related risks in Pakistan, while also contributing to drought, water shortages and damage to crops.
